title: Second-layer gate function
statement: Let $C$ be a depth circuit and let $I$ be a set of indices of its first-layer gates. On each sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, evaluate the first-layer gates and apply the gate dual to the resulting values at indices in $I$; the resulting sign-valued function is the second-layer gate function.
hypotheses_covered: A depth circuit on that dimension
A finite set of valid first-layer gate indices
